echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: Boosts her ATK-scaling heals and grants the team 15% ATK for 30s; Bell-Borne adds a transferable shield.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Sub-DPS-leaning option: faster Liberation casts and a DMG deepen for the next Resonator via Outro.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds + Lingering Tunes
echo_sets.note: While farming a full 5-piece set; keeps some offensive output without gutting her healing.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; Energy Regen is her #1 substat priority — stack it so her Liberation is available to pick the final antique each rotation
build.fast_path: Fast path: Abyss Surges + 5-piece Rejuvenating Glow in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Bell-Borne Geochelone in the main slot. Healing Bonus (or ATK%) 4-cost, Energy Regen (or ATK%) 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs. Collect antiques on-field, use Liberation to pick the final one, then Outro into your coordinated-attack DPS — she only shines on teams with coordinated attackers.

ranked_weapons.name: Abyss Surges
ranked_weapons.note: Game8's best weapon for Youhu: high Energy Regen for her Liberation plus ATK% that feeds her healing. Not her signature.

ranked_weapons.name: Celestial Spiral
ranked_weapons.note: 4-star alternative: restores Resonance Energy on Resonance Skill and boosts ATK.

ranked_weapons.name: Hollow Mirage
ranked_weapons.note: High ATK% substat and passive; boosts her on-field damage while keeping heals respectable.

ranked_weapons.name: Gauntlets of Night
ranked_weapons.note: 3-star stopgap with ATK% on Intro Skill; use only until a better gauntlet drops.

ranked_weapons.name: Marcato
ranked_weapons.note: Energy Regen substat plus Concerto Energy restore on Resonance Skill — PocketTactics' top pick for a low-cost build.

stat_priorities.note: Healing Bonus is standard; ATK% works since her heals scale off ATK.
Energy Regen on both 3-costs, or ATK% if ER substats already cover her.
ATK% on both; feeds her ATK-scaling heals.

profile.role_note: Coordinated-attack niche healer: her Outro amplifies the team's coordinated attacks, but her Antique buffs are RNG-based and her healing is the only consistent part of her kit.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Only invest if you run a coordinated-attack DPS like Jinhsi or Zhezhi — that's the one niche where she beats the free Baizhi. For general healing she's skippable, and her RNG antique mechanic makes her inconsistent everywhere else.

sources.record: Wuthering Waves Character Tier List for Version 3.7

members.name: Jinhsi
members.note: Main DPS whose Incandescence charges fastest off coordinated attacks — the exact niche Youhu buffs.

members.name: Zhezhi
members.note: Coordinated-attack sub-DPS; Youhu's Outro directly amplifies her coordinated attack DMG.

members.name: Youhu
members.note: Heals and buffs; opens the rotation generating antiques and picks the final one with her Liberation.

teams.name: Premium: Jinhsi + Zhezhi + Youhu
teams.rotation: Youhu opens, generating antique pairs until she has three, then uses her Liberation to choose the fourth and swaps to Zhezhi — Zhezhi's coordinated attacks hit harder under Youhu's Outro — then builds into Jinhsi's Incarnation burst, feeding Incandescence the whole way.

members.name: Zhezhi
members.note: Takes the main-DPS slot here; her Outro buffs Sanhua's Glacio DMG while Sanhua buffs her Basic Attack DMG.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Sub-DPS duo partner with Zhezhi; her ice explosions and Basic Attack buffs make the pair symbiotic.

members.name: Youhu
members.note: Buffs Zhezhi's coordinated attacks, which proc even while Sanhua is on-field; provides the team's healing.

teams.name: Alternative: Zhezhi + Sanhua + Youhu
teams.rotation: Youhu generates antiques and uses Liberation for the final pick, swaps to Zhezhi for her combo and Liberation under the coordinated-attack amp, then Sanhua takes field time with buffed Basic Attacks while Zhezhi's coordinated attacks keep firing.

tier_badge.label: Situational
tier_badge.note: Game8 rates her C overall and Beebom's October 2026 3.7 tier list places her at C — a solid but RNG-gated coordinated-attack specialist; her healing is consistent but Baizhi does the generalist job for free.
